name: Supabase
purpose: Postgres database, storage, and realtime for client data.

tasks.title: Create separate staging and production projects
steps: One project per environment, in the region closest to the client's users
Turn on Point-in-Time Recovery for production
tasks.doneWhen: Both projects exist; production backups are on.

tasks.title: Manage schema as migrations
steps: All schema changes live in supabase/migrations and are applied by CI
No manual edits in the production dashboard
tasks.doneWhen: A fresh database built from migrations matches production.

tasks.title: Enable Row Level Security on every table
steps: RLS on for every table in public schema
Policies key on the signed-in user's ID (Clerk user ID when Clerk is the identity provider, NN-CLERK-04)
tasks.doneWhen: Database linter reports no tables without RLS; user A cannot read user B's rows.

tasks.title: Keep the service role key server-only
steps: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is never prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_ and never imported by client code
tasks.doneWhen: Searching the built client bundle finds no service role key.

tasks.title: Apply migrations to staging first
steps: Run migrations on staging, run Playwright against it, then promote to production
tasks.doneWhen: Production migration applied after a green staging run.

tasks.title: Monthly backup restore test
steps: Restore the latest backup into a scratch project and check row counts
Review the security and performance advisors
tasks.doneWhen: Restore succeeded and advisors show no critical items.
